product_brief: A comprehensive suite of FIPS Approved algorithms implemented in pure Java.
pqc_capability_description: The document lists only classical cryptographic algorithms (AES, RSA, DSA, ECDSA, SHA, etc.) approved under FIPS 140-3. There is no mention of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithms, hybrid schemes, or PQC migration plans.
crypto_primitives: AES, DSA, ECDSA, RSA, SHA-1, SHA-2, SHA-3, HMAC, KMAC, cSHAKE, KDF, KAS-ECC, KAS-FFC, KAS-IFC, KTS-IFC, PBKDF, Counter DRBG, Hash DRBG, HMAC DRBG
primary_platforms: Android 16, VMware Photon OS 4.0/5.0, HP-UX, Linux (Centos, Debian, Fedora, Oracle RHC/UEK, Photon, SUSE, Ubuntu), Mac OS X, Microsoft Windows/Server/XP, Solaris, AIX, ClevOS
target_industries: US Federal agencies and other markets requiring FIPS 140-3 validation
testing_&_validation_methods: CAVP tested algorithms; FIPS 140-3 validation by Acumen Security; Pre-Operational and Conditional Self-Tests
qrng_&_entropy_sources: Uses DRBGs (Counter, Hash, HMAC); guidance for configuring JVM’s Entropy Source; External RNG usage mentioned
